backpack.attach: BoneAttachment3D under %GeneralSkeleton with bone_name 'UpperChest'; instance worn_scene (or worn_plain_scene) as its child with an identity transform (the bag sits at Bag.transform = attach_local inside the scene)
backpack.track_format: bag_track / package_track: one entry per frame at 30 fps (frame = clip time * 30, frames 0..N), [px, py, pz, qx, qy, qz, qw] = transform of the bag / package scene root in Courier-root space (the node that holds the AnimationPlayer root; Courier faces -Z): node.transform = Transform3D(Basis(Quaternion(qx, qy, qz, qw)), Vector3(px, py, pz)) for a child of that node. Interpolate between frames. flap_deg: held bag Flap.rotation.x in degrees (0 closed, 180 hanging open). events [{frame, do, ...}]: bag_socket -> back (worn scene on the bone, held bag hidden) / track (held bag driven by bag_track, worn scene hidden); body_strap_l / body_strap_r = visible of BackpackStrapL / R in the courier; bag_strap_l / bag_strap_r = visible of StrapL / StrapR of the held bag; package -> track (follow package_track) / bag (parent into the top compartment, Slot_Top) / released (customer takes it, or it stays where package_track ends).

bike.crank_contract: Bike_Pedal / Bike_Stand_Pedal: one clip second = one crank revolution, crank rotation.x = -angle; crank_rad per frame for the other bike clips

Bag_Hold.note: standing, the open bag held in front: left hand on the top handle, right palm on its side

Bag_PackItem.note: left hand holds the bag; the right hand brings the package (lying on the palm) in and pushes it into the top compartment

Bag_PutOn.note: a flick of the left hand swings the flap up, the right palm presses it shut, the bag swings to the left side and up onto the back (left arm through the left strap), right arm into the right strap, settle

Bag_PutOn_Holding.note: the right hand keeps the package; a flick of the left hand shuts the flap, the bag swings round the left side onto the left shoulder only (right strap stays off), both hands take the package (ends in the Carry_Idle pose). Follow with Handover / PlaceDown, then Bag_StrapRight

Bag_StrapRight.note: bag on the left shoulder only: the right arm reaches back into the right strap and pulls it onto the shoulder (ends in the Bag_Worn_Idle pose)

Bag_TakeItem.note: the right hand reaches into the top compartment, pulls the package out by its near edge and brings it out lying on the palm; the left hand holds the bag

Bag_TakeOff.note: right strap off, the bag slides down the left arm into the left hand, comes round to the front, flap drops open towards the courier

Bag_Worn_Idle.note: Idle wearing the backpack: thumbs hooked under the shoulder straps (the library Idle's hands-behind pose would go through the bag)

Bike_Bell.note: right thumb flicks the bell lever twice (bell assumed just inboard of the right grip; the gray bicycle has no bell model yet)

Bike_Brake.note: seated, pedals level: index and middle fingers reach forward to the brake levers (in front of the grips) and pull; the body braces against the deceleration; ends holding the levers

Bike_Coast.note: freewheeling: seated, pedals level (crank at rest, right forward), relaxed look around; crank does not turn

Bike_Dismount.note: from the Bike_Seated pose: stand on the left foot, the right leg swings back over the saddle and steps down at the left of the bike; ends standing beside the bike with both hands on the grips (the game hands over to Idle with a blend)

Bike_Look_Back.note: coasting shoulder check over the left shoulder (torso twist + head turn), hands stay on the grips

Bike_Mount.note: from standing at the left of the bike with both hands on the grips: weight onto the left foot, the right leg swings up and back over the saddle and down onto the forward right pedal, sit, the left foot steps to its toe-down spot; ends in the Bike_Seated pose

Bike_Pedal.note: seated pedalling, one forward crank revolution per clip second; frame k <-> crank angle 360*k/30 deg from rest (right crank forward, Crank rotation.x = -angle)

Bike_Seated.note: stopped on the saddle: left foot down on its toes beside the bike, right foot on the forward pedal (crank at rest), breathing

Bike_Stand_Pedal.note: out of the saddle (climb / sprint), one forward crank revolution per clip second like Bike_Pedal; the body sways over the down-stroke pedal

Car_Drive.note: driver's seat, both hands on the steering wheel with small steering corrections; feet set to z 0 (put the root on the car floor)

Carry_Idle.note: standing, a package held in front with both hands (forearms level)

Carry_Walk.note: Walk with a package held in front with both hands; legs, feet and speed exactly as Walk

ClimbUp_1m.note: climb up onto a 1 m ledge (feet on z 0 at frame 0); the clip is in place: move the root along root_motion_samples_30fps (Courier-root frame) from the library's root-motion version

Consume_Item.note: uses / shows an item held out in the left hand (library 'Consume'; not hand-to-mouth: see Eat_Drink)

Eat_Drink.note: drinks / eats from the right hand: the item (attach to hand_r) reaches the mouth at frame 19, held to frame 46 with the head tipped back, then lowered

Get_Up.note: get up from lying on the ground to standing (after a bike crash)

Handover.note: offer the package forward with both hands, weight shifting onto the balls of the feet and a slight lean; the customer takes it at frame 20 with a small nod toward their hands, hands come back and the body settles

Hit_Knockback.note: knocked back by a hit (bike crash / collision)

Idle.note: relaxed standing idle: feet under the hips, arms hanging beside the thighs, the library idle's breathing and sway

Interact_Bag.note: Interact with the backpack worn: the arms ease round the bag (same legs and speed)

Jog_Bag.note: Jog with the backpack worn: the arms ease round the bag (natural jog)

Jump.note: in-air loop, legs tucked, pelvis at the same height as the end of Jump_Start / start of Jump_Land

Jump_Bag.note: Jump with the backpack worn: the arms ease round the bag (in-air loop, legs tucked, pelvis at the same height as the end of Jump_Start / start of Jump_Land)

Jump_Land.note: in the air at the Jump_Loop pelvis height, touch-down at frame 0, landing compression, recover to standing

Jump_Land_Bag.note: Jump_Land with the backpack worn: the arms ease round the bag (in the air at the Jump_Loop pelvis height, touch-down at frame 0, landing compression, recover to standing)

Jump_Start.note: anticipation crouch, extension and toe-off (frame 15); after take-off the pelvis stays at air height (0.94 m) and the legs tuck: the CharacterBody provides the vertical motion

Jump_Start_Bag.note: Jump_Start with the backpack worn: the arms ease round the bag (anticipation crouch, extension and toe-off (frame 15); after take-off the pelvis stays at air height (0.94 m) and the legs tuck: the CharacterBody provides the vertical motion)

Knock_Door.note: three knocks with the right fist on a door 0.50 m in front of the courier (knuckles touch at frames 16, 23, 30)

Land_Hard.note: Jump_Land with a deep knee bend

Land_Hard_Bag.note: Land_Hard with the backpack worn: the arms ease round the bag (Jump_Land with a deep knee bend)

Look_Back.note: shoulder check over the left shoulder while standing (feet planted), back to the front

Open_Box.note: kneels / bends and lifts a lid open with both hands (a package box or a locker)

Phone_Call.note: phone call: phone at the ear, talking, small weight shifts (phone_track gives the phone in the hand)

Phone_Lower.note: Phone_Use -> Idle: the phone goes back to the pocket (hidden from frame 16)

Phone_Raise.note: Idle -> Phone_Use: the phone comes up to reading height (phone visible from frame 6)

PickUp.note: squat (knees bent, back ~50 deg), both hands take the package from the ground 0.33 m in front (grab at frame 20), stand up holding it in front (ends in the Carry_Idle pose). package_track frame 0 = where the package must lie

PickUp_Shelf.note: lean in, both hands take a package standing on a shelf / counter at 0.90 m, 0.50 m in front (grab at frame 14), pull it in to the carry pose (ends in the Carry_Idle pose)

PickUp_Table_Bag.note: PickUp_Table with the backpack worn: the arms ease round the bag (same legs and speed)

PlaceDown.note: squat (knees bent, back ~50 deg) and set the package on the ground 0.33 m in front (leave at door), release at frame 19, stand up

Press_Doorbell.note: the right index finger presses a doorbell button beside the door (0.30 m to the right, 0.47 m ahead, 1.24 m high), pressed frames 14-20

Push.note: pushing forward with both hands at chest height (door, cart); walk the root at the measured speed, 0 = pushing in place

Roll.note: forward roll (hard-landing recovery), in place; the clip is in place: move the root along root_motion_samples_30fps (Courier-root frame) from the library's root-motion version

Run_Bag.note: Run with the backpack worn: the arms ease round the bag (natural run)

Sit_Enter.note: standing in front of a chair -> sitting (chair seat height: see Sit_Idle seat_height_m)

Sprint_Bag.note: Sprint with the backpack worn: the arms ease round the bag (natural sprint)

Strafe_L.note: side steps; the body moves to the character's left

Strafe_L_Bag.note: Strafe_L with the backpack worn: the arms ease round the bag (side steps; the body moves to the character's left)

Strafe_R.note: side steps; the body moves to the character's right

Strafe_R_Bag.note: Strafe_R with the backpack worn: the arms ease round the bag (side steps; the body moves to the character's right)

Throw.note: overhand throw (newspaper / package onto a porch); release at frame 11 (right hand, 21.8 m/s)

Turn_L_90_Bag.note: Turn_L_90 with the backpack worn: the arms ease round the bag (same legs and speed)

Turn_R_90_Bag.note: Turn_R_90 with the backpack worn: the arms ease round the bag (same legs and speed)

Walk.note: natural walk, 112 steps/min: heel strike, roll, toe-off; pelvis bob, sway and rotation, spine counter-rotation, level head, arms swinging opposite the legs

Walk_Back.note: walking backwards: the natural walk reversed in time and slowed (ball-first landing, heel lowers, toes lift last); the body moves backwards

Walk_Back_Bag.note: Walk_Back with the backpack worn: the arms ease round the bag (walking backwards: the natural walk reversed in time and slowed (ball-first landing, heel lowers, toes lift last); the body moves backwards)

Walk_Bag.note: Walk with the backpack worn: the arms ease round the bag (natural walk, 112 steps/min: heel strike, roll, toe-off; pelvis bob, sway and rotation, spine counter-rotation, level head, arms swinging opposite the legs)

Wave.note: friendly wave with the right hand raised beside the head (three side-to-side swings), arm comes back down

facing: Courier root faces -Z; the model inside is turned PI (retarget convention +Z)
